name: Jasper National Park
policyReason: Parks Canada says most Jasper trails outside caribou habitat are dog friendly; only listed sensitive-habitat trails ban dogs.
summary: Leashed dogs can use most trails, except those in caribou and other sensitive habitat.

excerpts.quote: Most trails in Jasper National Park that do not enter into Caribou habitat are dog friendly, which means you and your furry friend can go almost anywhere you want!
Dogs are prohibited on the following specified trails and areas of Jasper National Park.

dogRules.text: Dogs are banned in sensitive habitat, including the Skyline, Bald Hills, Opal Hills, Maligne Pass, Brazeau Loop/Poboktan and Tonquin Valley trails, within 500 m of each trail.
Dogs must be leashed to protect ground-nesting birds such as the common nighthawk.
